title: AutoFraming: Synthesizing Dynamic Frames of C Code with LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.29046v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown considerable promise in synthesizing formal specifications from source code. However, existing approaches primarily focus on functional contracts and loop invariants, while largely neglecting frame conditions, which specify the memory locations that may or may not be modified during execution and constitute an essential part of formal specifications. To address this limitation, we propose an LLM-based approach for synthesizing ACSL frame specifications alongside functional contracts from C code. Our approach analyzes code property graphs (CPGs) to extract frame-relevant information from the input code and leverages this information to guide the LLM in generating accurate frame conditions. The resulting specifications capture both region-separation constraints and data dependencies that govern variable modifications. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. On a benchmark

translated_title: AutoFraming：利用大语言模型综合C代码的动态帧条件
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在从源代码综合形式化规范方面已展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有方法主要关注函数契约和循环不变式，而在很大程度上忽略了帧条件——帧条件规定了执行期间哪些内存位置可能被修改或不得被修改，是形式化规范的重要组成部分。为解决这一局限，我们提出了一种基于LLM的方法，用于从C代码中同时综合ACSL帧规范和函数契约。我们的方法通过分析代码属性图（CPGs）从输入代码中提取与帧相关的信息，并利用这些信息引导LLM生成准确的帧条件。所得规范既捕获了区域分离约束，也捕获了支配变量修改的数据依赖关系。实验结果表明了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出AutoFraming方法，通过分析代码属性图提取帧相关信息以引导大语言模型，从C代码中自动综合出同时捕获区域分离约束和数据依赖关系的ACSL帧规范，弥补了现有形式化规范综合技术忽视帧条件的不足。
en_tdlr: AutoFraming analyzes code property graphs to extract frame-relevant information and guide LLMs in synthesizing accurate ACSL frame specifications from C code, capturing region-separation constraints and data dependencies overlooked by existing approaches.
